summary: First test run for TradeAcademy MVP. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me/forgot), courses (18 modules), progress complete/uncomplete flow, live-sessions/testimonials/contact, and full admin RBAC + CRUD (module/lesson/live-session). Frontend: verified student login -> dashboard (welcome, stats, continue-btn), lesson view (mark-complete toggles state and persists via API, prev/next present), 18 modules render on /courses, contact form submits and shows success toast, registration flow lands on dashboard, admin login can access /admin with all 5 tabs (content/users/live/testimonials/messages), users tab shows demo student, and logout via user-menu-trigger -> menu-logout clears session and redirects to /login.

issues: Input fields have a white background inside a dark themed page — visually inconsistent with the rest of the dark theme (see screenshot). Consider bg-navy-2/border-white/10 like Login inputs.

action_items: Optional: rename Admin CrudList-generated testids for consistency — 'Live Sessions' becomes data-testid="add-live-sessions" (not add-live). The spec listed add-live/add-lesson-<id> etc. Not blocking but harmonize naming.
Contact form input styling: white input backgrounds inside dark theme look off; align with Login/Register input styles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /admin/testimonials has no PUT endpoint (only POST/DELETE). Admin UI may not support editing testimonials. Minor.
server.py: forgot-password is intentionally a no-op mock (documented as mocked) — fine.
server.py: admin/courses/{course_id} DELETE does not cascade-delete modules/lessons (only del_module does). Consider cascading if course deletion is ever exposed in UI.
server.py: no rate limiting on /auth/login or /auth/register — acceptable for MVP but worth flagging.
public_user() includes email — fine, but /admin/users returns all user fields except password_hash (still includes email, auth_provider). OK for admin.
Dashboard.js: no loading/error state while course/progress fetch (silent .catch). Consider a skeleton or error toast.
Frontend loads /auth/me before login and gets 401 which is expected but shows a console error — could be suppressed with a 401 interceptor.
test_credentials: student@demo.com / Demo1234 (student), admin@demo.com / Admin1234 (admin) — both working.
seed_data_creation: Seed runs on backend startup (seed.py): course_main + 18 modules (first 2 free) with 2 lessons each = 36 lessons, live sessions, testimonials, demo student and admin. Confirmed via /api/courses/course_main/full returning 18 modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All admin CRUD is validated (module->lesson creation, edit, cascade-delete). Google OAuth flow not automated (requires Emergent session). Contact form input styling is the only design nit noted. add-testimonial / testimonial edit not covered — no PUT endpoint exists server-side.
rca of the issue: N/A — no reproducible bugs found in tested flows.
